edges.parent_basis:
The constitution's own title states the descent: the Roman Missal restored BY
DECREE OF THE SECOND VATICAN ECUMENICAL COUNCIL is promulgated. Its opening
sentence then recites the other end of the line as well -- the Missal
promulgated by our predecessor St Pius V in the year 1570 by decree of the
Council of Trent -- with a footnote citing Quo primum by title and by day.
